title: U.S. DOJ to Seize $584K in Crypto Linked to Iranian Drone Supplier
summary: The DOJ has filed a forfeiture to recover $584K in USDT from an unhosted wallet allegedly tied to Mohammad Abedini or SDRA. Prosecutors have said SDRA navigation systems have been used in IRGC drones, including one tied to a Jan. 2024 attack in Jordan. Abedini has been indicted and is presumed innocent.
